content: {"phoneNote":"The phone hero crops the photo to a wall of leaves and trunk so the house is lost, though the overlapping white card with address, headline and one link reads cleanly.","desktopNote":"Below the hero the layout loosens: the group-reservation headline wraps into four lines in a narrow column leaving the right 60% of the section empty, and the contact block has a large dead band above its headline.","phone":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":3,"spacing":4,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":4},"desktop":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":4,"spacing":2,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":4},"fixes":["Desktop: let the 'Sprejemamo rezervacije za skupine' and 'Pokličite za rezervacijo' headlines run wider (max two lines) and tighten vertical padding so the sections have no empty halves or dead bands.","Phone: reposition the hero image (focal point on the house front, benches and door) so the first screen shows the gostilna, not only foliage; raise the card slightly so 'Poglejte ponudbo' is not pushed to the bar.","Both: the footer repeats phone and e-mail already shown in the contact section just above; reduce footer to company data, legal links and copyright."],"blockers":["Desktop, family section: the dining-room photo hangs below its section and crosses the divider line above 'Sprejemamo rezervacije', overlapping the next section's top edge."]}
